subject: executor: change the evaluation order of columns in `Update` and `Insert` statements (#57123)
summary: Reviewed this commit relative to its first parent, focusing on executor changes. The core behavior change moves generated-column evaluation into `updateRecord` so the order becomes: non-generated columns (pre-evaluated by callers) → change detection → ON UPDATE NOW timestamp fill → generated columns evaluation (with eval buffer/offset) → FK/bad-null/exchange-partition checks → write. Update and INSERT...ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE call sites appear wired correctly (per-table virtual assignments for UPDATE; generated vs non-generated split for ON DUPLICATE), and the added regression tests for #56829 exercise the intended index consistency fix. No remaining Blocker/High issues found.
